title: Figure 13: Superconducting toroidal capacitor and its discharge onto the target
description: Two-part schematic captioned 'Figure 13. The Superconducting Toroidal Capacitor (a) and Its Discharge Onto the Target (b)'. Panel (a) shows Super Marx capacitor stages with magnetic insulation, a laser, a toroidal capacitor ring with electron flows and B > E notation, and an H2 jet toward the D2 target; panel (b) shows the proton beam striking a starburst target. Bulleted text above explains the laser-triggered discharge sequence.
